item.title: Teaching YOLO Your Own Objects
item.description: Fourth post in the Luckfox build log: a short guide to training YOLOv8n on just your own objects and images, instead of the 80 everyday classes it ships with, and getting the result onto the RV1106's NPU.

item.title: How Neural Networks Learn to Tell a Cat From a Dog
item.description: The same 25,000 Kaggle cat and dog photos, four ways: a scikit-learn neural network, the identical network in PyTorch, a small convolutional network, and a pretrained YOLOv8 -- every number from code you can run.

item.title: Round 5: Training a 7B Credit Analyst
item.description: Training results from Round 5 QLoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-7B for automated bank credit analysis. 6,359 training pairs, 3 epochs on an A100 80GB, and what the loss curve reveals about when to stop training.

item.title: Socio-Economic Credit Models: The Future of Fair Lending
item.description: How integrating gender equality and regional context data can improve credit scoring, expand market access, and demonstrate fair lending practices.

item.title: The Infinity Machine: Demis Hassabis, DeepMind and the Quest for Superintelligence
item.description: Sebastian Mallaby's account of Demis Hassabis and the race to build machine intelligence. The biography the subject actually wanted written.

item.title: Deep Learning
item.description: THE textbook. Rigorous mathematical treatment of neural networks from first principles. Available free at deeplearningbook.org.
